title: nerve-wml v1.10.0: Substrate-Agnostic Nerve Protocol — NH-01 Dreaming Hopfield Replication (N = 1 000), N10-C Freeze, Edge-Null Primitives, L1a Gate Erratum
description:
v1.10.0 is the first release published on GitHub and archived on Zenodo since v1.8.1 (2026-05-10). The June 2026 work recorded in CHANGELOG.md as 1.9.0 (tag only) and 1.9.1 to 1.9.4 (no tag) was never released, so no Zenodo record exists for it; this version archives it together with the October 2026 work.

Correction carried by this release (L1a gate). The v1.9.0 changelog claimed that the Full-LIF L1a gate was closed. The gate specification requires an untrained accuracy of at most 10 %; the recorded run (seed 0, n = 1024) has 13.1 %, and the training script never evaluated that condition. The claim holds only for the other two conditions; the learned gain is unchanged (89.1 % final vs 13.1 % untrained, chance 8.3 %). The gate script now checks all three conditions. Details: docs/superpowers/research/2026-10-24-lif-l1a-gate-erratum.md. Two further dated errata (2026-10-25) requalify the N-3 ablations (inactive mechanism, Δ = 0 uninformative, issue #71) and stale facts in Paper 1 and metadata (issue #64).

NH-01, dreaming Hopfield kernel vs uniform shrink (track M, issue #68). Pre-registered replication of the Fachechi–Agliari–Barra dreaming kernel at finite N, numpy only. Pilot at N = 256 (tag prereg-nh01-hopfield-dream-20261025, 28 080 cells): confirmed under the pre-registered rule (C1 ratio 3.43 [3.26, 3.60] at t = 10; C3 shrink ratio 1.000 at T = 0, 0.980 at T = 0.2). Confirmatory run at N = 1 000 (tag prereg-nh01-confirmatory-20261025): confirmed, C1 ratio 3.86 [3.79, 3.93], t* = 7, matched shrink 0.975 [0.967, 0.982] at T = 0.2. Correlated patterns at N = 1 000 (tag prereg-nh01-correlated-20261027): confirmed at m = 0 and m = 0.15; m = 0.30: registered C1 ratio 44.38 [42.56, 46.97] confirmed under the pre-registered rule (every Hebbian crossing bracketed by the loads 0.01 and 0.02, magnitude grid-sensitive), post-analysis assessment inconclusive (C3′ undefined on 5/10 seeds at T = 0.2). Per-cell outputs, SHA-256 sums and run metadata are in results/nh01, results/nh01_confirmatory and results/nh01_correlated.

N10-C emergent-communication campaign. Frozen configuration and manifest for run 2 (tags n10c-freeze-20261024 and n10c-freeze-20261029, SWHID of the 20261029 tag swh:1:rel:b14717b7efbbee111b577debce981e9b58795d19), launch guards that refuse any registered budget outside a freeze context, the 16 pinned pre-trained trunks, and the N10-C-bis control-arms addendum (three arms scripted, no run yet). No N10-C result is reported in this version.

June 2026 work archived here for the first time (1.9.0 to 1.9.4). Panzeri–Treves bias-corrected mutual-information estimator with permutation null (ADR-0001; the post-VQ MI/H figure 0.931 must always be cited with the pre-VQ KSG value 0.095); prior-art reframing of cross-architecture convergence (ADR-0002); SpikingKikiWML substrate scaffold; diagonal-Fisher EWC vs rehearsal comparison; Full-LIF L1a training and scaling sweep (see the erratum above); accuracy edge-null primitives (nerve_wml.methodology.accuracy_edge_null) with committed replication drivers and n = 50 null artefacts; Paper 1 fidelity-ratio and round-trip restatements.

Single author: Clément Saillant (ORCID 0000-0002-8414-185X), Hypneum Lab. MIT code, CC BY 4.0 documentation. Parent pre-registration: OSF 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q6JYN.
